{
  "candidate_rtl": "module pw_alu #(
    parameter WIDTH = 64
)(
    input wire [WIDTH-1:0] a, b,
    input wire [2:0] Oper,
    output reg [WIDTH-1:0] sum
);
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] p = a ^ b;
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] np = ~p;
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] ga = a & b;
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] gs = a & ~b;
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] gr = b & ~a;
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] ca, cs, cr;
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] add_result = p ^ ca;
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] sub_result = np ^ cs;
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] reverse_result = np ^ cr;

    pw_alu_carry #(.WIDTH(WIDTH)) u_add (
        .p(p), .g(ga), .cin(1'b0), .c(ca)
    );
    pw_alu_carry #(.WIDTH(WIDTH)) u_sub (
        .p(np), .g(gs), .cin(1'b1), .c(cs)
    );
    pw_alu_carry #(.WIDTH(WIDTH)) u_reverse (
        .p(np), .g(gr), .cin(1'b1), .c(cr)
    );

    wire sel_add = (Oper == 3'b000);
    wire sel_sub = (Oper == 3'b001);
    wire sel_reverse = (Oper == 3'b010);
    wire sel_or = (Oper == 3'b011);
    wire sel_and = (Oper == 3'b100);
    wire sel_xor = (Oper == 3'b101);
    wire sel_xnor = (Oper == 3'b110);

    always @* begin
        sum = ({WIDTH{sel_add}} & add_result)
            | ({WIDTH{sel_sub}} & sub_result)
            | ({WIDTH{sel_reverse}} & reverse_result)
            | ({WIDTH{sel_or}} & (a | b))
            | ({WIDTH{sel_and}} & ga)
            | ({WIDTH{sel_xor}} & p)
            | ({WIDTH{sel_xnor}} & np);
    end
endmodule

module pw_alu_carry #(
    parameter WIDTH = 64
)(
    input wire [WIDTH-1:0] p,
    input wire [WIDTH-1:0] g,
    input wire cin,
    output wire [WIDTH-1:0] c
);
    localparam BLOCKS = (WIDTH + 3) / 4;
    localparam PAD_WIDTH = 4 * BLOCKS;
    localparam LEVELS = $clog2(BLOCKS);
    wire [PAD_WIDTH-1:0] pp, gg;
    wire [BLOCKS-1:0] bp [0:LEVELS];
    wire [BLOCKS-1:0] bg [0:LEVELS];
    wire [BLOCKS-1:0] bc;
    wire [PAD_WIDTH-1:0] cc;

    genvar i, k, level;
    generate
        for (i = 0; i < PAD_WIDTH; i = i + 1) begin: pad
            if (i < WIDTH) begin: real_bit
                assign pp[i] = p[i];
                assign gg[i] = g[i];
            end else begin: unused_bit
                assign pp[i] = 1'b1;
                assign gg[i] = 1'b0;
            end
        end
        for (k = 0; k < BLOCKS; k = k + 1) begin: block_terms
            assign bp[0][k] = &pp[4*k +: 4];
            assign bg[0][k] = gg[4*k+3]
                | (pp[4*k+3] & gg[4*k+2])
                | (pp[4*k+3] & pp[4*k+2] & gg[4*k+1])
                | (pp[4*k+3] & pp[4*k+2] & pp[4*k+1] & gg[4*k]);
        end
        for (level = 0; level < LEVELS; level = level + 1) begin: prefix_level
            for (k = 0; k < BLOCKS; k = k + 1) begin: prefix_node
                if (k >= (1 << level)) begin: combine
                    assign bp[level+1][k] = bp[level][k] & bp[level][k-(1 << level)];
                    assign bg[level+1][k] = bg[level][k]
                        | (bp[level][k] & bg[level][k-(1 << level)]);
                end else begin: bypass
                    assign bp[level+1][k] = bp[level][k];
                    assign bg[level+1][k] = bg[level][k];
                end
            end
        end
        for (k = 0; k < BLOCKS; k = k + 1) begin: local_carries
            if (k == 0) begin: first_block
                assign bc[k] = cin;
            end else begin: later_block
                assign bc[k] = bg[LEVELS][k-1] | (bp[LEVELS][k-1] & cin);
            end
            assign cc[4*k] = bc[k];
            assign cc[4*k+1] = gg[4*k] | (pp[4*k] & bc[k]);
            assign cc[4*k+2] = gg[4*k+1]
                | (pp[4*k+1] & gg[4*k])
                | (pp[4*k+1] & pp[4*k] & bc[k]);
            assign cc[4*k+3] = gg[4*k+2]
                | (pp[4*k+2] & gg[4*k+1])
                | (pp[4*k+2] & pp[4*k+1] & gg[4*k])
                | (pp[4*k+2] & pp[4*k+1] & pp[4*k] & bc[k]);
        end
    endgenerate
    assign c = cc[WIDTH-1:0];
endmodule",
  "bottleneck": "The likely critical path is arithmetic carry propagation followed by result selection. Sharing a single arithmetic unit would additionally put operation-dependent operand inversion or swapping ahead of that carry path.",
  "rewrite": "Compute all three arithmetic results in parallel using four-bit carry-lookahead blocks and a logarithmic prefix network between blocks. Share the input XOR and its complement across arithmetic and logical operations. Use mutually exclusive decoded output masks so operation selection remains after the arithmetic networks.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "The WIDTH=16 implementation replaces a potentially long carry dependency with four local blocks and two inter-block prefix levels. This is intended to reduce maximum arithmetic data arrival without introducing an operation-select path into carry generation. Numerical improvement requires synthesis and STA under the specified mapping and constraints; no measured gain is claimed.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Three parallel carry networks trade area for timing, while sharing propagate signals and logical intermediates. Four-bit grouping limits prefix-network wiring and cell count compared with three full bit-level prefix adders. Compliance with the 3074.698880um2 cap and electrical limits must be confirmed by the evaluation flow.",
  "functional_boundaries": "Preserves the pw_alu interface, unsigned ports, WIDTH parameter and default WIDTH=64. Addition and both subtraction directions are computed modulo 2^WIDTH. Oper values 000 through 110 retain their original meanings, and 111 returns zero. The design is purely combinational, accepts arbitrary binary inputs, and adds no state, latency, assumptions or undefined outputs."
}
